func mapOSError(err error) int32 {
	if err == nil {
		return _wasiESUCCESS
	}
	switch {
	case errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist):
		return _wasiENOENT
	case errors.Is(err, fs.ErrExist):
		return _wasiEEXIST
	case errors.Is(err, fs.ErrPermission):
		return _wasiEACCES
	case errors.Is(err, syscall.ENOTDIR):
		return _wasiENOTDIR
	case errors.Is(err, syscall.EISDIR):
		return _wasiEISDIR
	case errors.Is(err, syscall.EINVAL):
		return _wasiEINVAL
	case errors.Is(err, syscall.EBADF):
		return _wasiEBADF
	case errors.Is(err, syscall.EAGAIN):
		return _wasiEAGAIN
	case errors.Is(err, syscall.EPIPE):
		return _wasiEPIPE
	}
	return _wasiEIO
}

func (w *WasiStubs) Fd_allocate(m *Module, fd int32, offset, length int64) int32 {
	w.mu.Lock()
	op := w.fdTable[fd]
	w.mu.Unlock()
	if op == nil || op.f == nil {
		return _wasiEBADF
	}

	start, count := uint64(offset), uint64(length)
	if start > uint64(1<<63-1) || count > uint64(1<<63-1)-start {
		return 27
	}
	end := int64(start + count)

	if count == 0 {
		end = 0
	}
	if allocator, ok := op.f.(interface{ Allocate(int64) error }); ok {
		return mapOSError(allocator.Allocate(end))
	}
	if _, ok := op.f.(*os.File); !ok {
		return _wasiENOTSUP
	}
	unlock := lockNativeFileResize(op.f)
	defer unlock()

	if _, err := op.f.Write(nil); err != nil {
		return mapOSError(err)
	}
	info, err := op.f.Stat()
	if err != nil {
		return mapOSError(err)
	}
	if info.IsDir() {
		return _wasiEISDIR
	}
	if end > info.Size() {
		if err := op.f.Truncate(end); err != nil {
			return mapOSError(err)
		}
	}
	return _wasiESUCCESS
}
